name: NINE CARD BRAG
description: Nine Card Brag (often called 'Crash') is the final evolution of the multi-card Brag family. Players are dealt nine cards and must divide them into three independent three-card hands. These hands are compared against opponents' corresponding hands in three separate 'showdowns' (front, middle, and back). It combines the traditional British Brag hand rankings with the partition complexity of Chinese Poker, creating a high-stakes duel of distribution and nerve.

content.text: Nine Card Brag (often called 'Crash') is the final evolution of the multi-card Brag family. Players are dealt nine cards and must divide them into three independent three-card hands. These hands are compared against opponents' corresponding hands in three separate 'showdowns' (front, middle, and back). It combines the traditional British Brag hand rankings with the partition complexity of Chinese Poker, creating a high-stakes duel of distribution and nerve.

Originating in the card rooms of Northern England and Scotland, 9-Card Brag emerged as a more complex alternative to the simpler vying variants. It likely took inspiration from the global 'partition' genre while strictly adhering to the centuries-old Brag combination hierarchy.
Standard pack, score pad or chips.
Deal nine cards face-down to each player. Players then divide their hand into three separate 3-card Brag combinations.

items.text: Crash (13-Card): Players receive 13 cards and form four Brag hands, leaving one card as a muck.
